services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Explore the wildlife of the bay! Rates Students & Chaperones $15 per person Teachers Free Duration 1 Hour or 90 Minutes About Our field trips feature three activities: On the way out, we drag our plankton net. After dragging our shrimp net, we empty our catch in the touch tank for you to see. The deckhand carefully removes any dangerous organisms and then allows you to see and touch certain species. services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Our sunset cruises leave Dauphin Island Marina and begin sailing west along the Coast of Dauphin Island. We get an up-close look at the oil and natural gas rigs in Mobile Bay and the Mississippi Sound. On our Dauphin Island sunset cruises, we also drag a shrimp net. The boat is equipped with a built-in touch tank aquarium. After dragging our shrimp net, we empty our catch in the touch tank for you to see. We often see dolphins on this cruise! We conclude our cruise by watching a relaxing sunset as we return to the dock. NOTE: Please reserve a seat for children 5 and under by selecting the ticket type “Young Children”.
